notes: conranshop.co.uk 301-redirects to theconranshop.com (confirmed same UK entity: Shopify shop 'the-conran-shop.myshopify.com', countryCode GB, currencyCode GBP, page branding 'The Conran Shop' throughout) - the retailer relaunched on a new domain, this is not a different company. Access: direct fetch worked with no WAF/robots block. Duplicate-company check: searched all 326 previously archived worker JSONs (c1.json-c326.json) in pipeline/json_archive for 'conran' in company name or brand_site - zero matches, not a duplicate of any earlier S.N. Count verification: this store's /collections/<handle>.json 'products_count' field is inflated (e.g. Lighting shows 109 there) - per project precedent, used /collections/<handle>/products.json paged-and-deduped counts instead, and cross-checked every number against the collection page's own rendered '<N> items' filter-widget text (Alpine.js widget, renders server-side) - all matched exactly. Built a full sitewide product_type census by paging /collections/all/products.json (689 live products total, matches the 627-URL product sitemap order of magnitude) to definitively test for Mirrors and Clocks. Exclusions applied: Mirrors - zero products of product_type 'Mirrors' anywhere in the sitewide census; /collections/all?filter.p.m.custom.product_type=Mirrors returns 0 results; zero 'mirror' substrings in the product sitemap URLs; the only trace is a stale marketing blurb on the Home Accessories page linking to that empty filter, so the category is dropped as genuinely absent, not unverifiable. Clocks - 0 results site search, 0 in census, 0 sitemap URL matches, dropped as absent. Desk Accessories, Pen Holders, Desk Organizers, Stationery, Games & Sports, Lighters & Matches, Storage Containers & Jars, Bar Soap - all out of scope (office/games/personal-care/functional storage, not decor) and dropped. Home Accessories and Candles Holders & Accessories are both mixed roll-up collections on this site (dinnerware, glassware, office supplies, games, soap, matches, scented candles, and true decor all share one URL) - did not use their collection-level counts; instead isolated exact in-scope subsets via the site's own Product Type filter facets and by manually title-scanning the full (small) product list. Scented candles (4 SKUs, 'Scented Candle 07/31/44/63') excluded as Home Fragrance; Lighters & Matches (6 SKUs) excluded as not decor; Wick Candles Blues/Neutrals 25cm (2 SKUs, stearin wax, no fragrance mentioned in product description) kept as unscented Candles; Wardour Candlestick + Wardour Stubby Candlestick (4 SKUs) kept as Candle Holders. Mugs, Cups & Jugs collection (45 items) overlaps 22 exact-title duplicate SKUs with the Glassware collection (Fade Glass Carafe/Tumbler and Nova Stripe Tumbler lines are cross-listed in both); to avoid double-counting against the Glassware row, the Kitchen & Dining qty used here is the 23 non-overlapping SKUs (verified via full title diff of both collections' products.json). Rule 0: no room-word exclusions applied - none of the site's own nav/category names carried room qualifiers that would have tempted a wrong exclusion.
